name: b_avgo_anthropic_financing_web
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Story: AVGO–Anthropic $60B Financing: Terms, Partners & Read-Throughs. Related tickers: AVGO, NVDA, GOOGL, TSM.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

Why this needs follow-up: Multiple sources cite different numbers ($42B senior vs $60B total vs $18B Blackstone junior) for the Broadcom–Anthropic deal, the notes are unconfirmed pre-IPO, and the read-through to NVDA, TSM, and other TPU/GPU suppliers is unquantified.

ANSWER EACH QUESTION (run a separate search for each):
- What are the confirmed terms of Broadcom's $42 billion senior secured convertible note facility for Anthropic as disclosed in Anthropic's IPO prospectus filed October 2026?
- Which financial institutions joined Blackstone in the reported $18 billion junior debt tranche of Broadcom's Anthropic chip-financing syndicate in October 2026?
- Which semiconductor suppliers—beyond Broadcom TPUs—are named in Anthropic's IPO prospectus as vendors for its $518 billion ten-year infrastructure commitment?

Name every stock affected by this story with its move, analyst notes that name winners and losers
(firm, rating, PT), exact figures (deal values, estimates, dates), and the latest status as of the
cutoff. Prefer Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, company releases, filings.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or sub-topic:

## TICKER or Sub-topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## AVGO [Anthropic financing]

- Anthropic’s October 2026 IPO prospectus disclosed that Broadcom agreed to provide **up to $42 billion** through **convertible notes** to finance Anthropic’s infrastructure spending, primarily obligations tied to TPU computing capacity. The facility could fund approximately one-third of Anthropic’s **$125.2 billion five-year TPU lease commitment**. (Reuters, Oct. 1, 2026; publication time not shown)

- The prospectus disclosed that Broadcom may **designate a financing partner**, and that notes issued under the facility could be converted into **Anthropic equity**. (Reuters, Oct. 1, 2026; publication time not shown)

- Anthropic said it **did not expect any notes to be sold before completion of its IPO**. (Reuters, Oct. 1, 2026; publication time not shown)

- The prospectus, as reported by Reuters, did **not disclose a conversion price, maturity date, or whether interest would be paid in cash or added to principal**. (Reuters, Oct. 1, 2026; publication time not shown)

- Anthropic deposited cash into a **restricted account for Broadcom’s benefit in April 2026** and could be required to contribute additional amounts under specified circumstances. (Reuters, Oct. 1, 2026; publication time not shown)

- The filing warned that specified payment or performance defaults could make a substantial portion of Anthropic’s lease obligations **immediately due** and could restrict Anthropic’s ability to draw on the $42 billion facility to fund those obligations. (Reuters, Oct. 1, 2026; publication time not shown)

- A separate reported financing package was described as **$60 billion total**, comprising a **$42 billion Class A senior-secured tranche** and an **$18 billion Class B junior tranche**; the package had not been publicly announced by the time of the report. [report] (Bloomberg, Oct. 2, 2026, 07:34 ET)

## Blackstone / financing syndicate [Report]

- **Blackstone** was reported to be leading an **$18 billion Class B junior-debt tranche** and committing **$9 billion from various funds**, with the remaining $9 billion intended for syndication. [report] (Bloomberg, Oct. 2, 2026, 07:34 ET)

- **Bank of America, Citigroup, and Morgan Stanley** were reported to be preparing syndication letters for the **$42 billion Class A senior-secured tranche**. [report] (Bloomberg, Oct. 2, 2026, 07:34 ET)

- The available reports did **not identify additional financial institutions** that had joined Blackstone in the reported $18 billion junior tranche as of the **October 5, 2026, 12:20 ET** cutoff. [report] (Bloomberg, Oct. 2, 2026, 07:34 ET)

## GOOGL [TPU supply and infrastructure]

- Anthropic’s prospectus-related reporting said Anthropic had committed **$125.2 billion over five years** for TPU computing capacity supplied through a Broadcom–Google arrangement, with supply expected to come online in **2027**. (Reuters, Oct. 1, 2026; publication time not shown)

- Broadcom designs Google’s TPUs, and Google was reported to provide TPU capacity to Anthropic under the arrangement. (Reuters, Oct. 1, 2026; publication time not shown)

- Anthropic’s reported ten-year infrastructure commitments included at least **$111.1 billion with Google**. (Prospectus summary reported Oct. 2, 2026; publication time not shown)

## Semiconductor suppliers named in the prospectus [Infrastructure vendors]

- The available search results identify **Broadcom** as the semiconductor supplier associated with Anthropic’s **$125.2 billion TPU-capacity commitment** and identify **Google** as the TPU-capacity provider. (Reuters, Oct. 1, 2026; publication time not shown)

- The available search results do **not name semiconductor suppliers beyond Broadcom and Google** in Anthropic’s prospectus disclosures concerning the reported **$518 billion ten-year infrastructure commitment** as of the cutoff.

- The reported infrastructure commitments included at least **$161.2 billion in Broadcom-related equipment leases**, but the available results do not establish that the full amount represents semiconductor purchases. (Prospectus summary reported Oct. 2, 2026; publication time not shown)

## AMZN, MSFT, xAI [Infrastructure counterparties]

- Anthropic’s reported ten-year infrastructure commitments included at least **$110 billion with Amazon**, **$31.4 billion with Microsoft**, and up to **$84.5 billion with xAI**; the xAI arrangement was reportedly terminable on **90 days’ notice**. (Prospectus summary reported Oct. 2, 2026; publication time not shown)

- The reported infrastructure commitment total was **at least $518 billion over ten years**, with approximately **80% described as non-cancelable or payable regardless of usage**. (Prospectus summary reported Oct. 2, 2026; publication time not shown)

## NVDA [Read-through]

- The available in-window reports did **not provide a quantified stock move, analyst rating change, price-target change, or named analyst note for NVDA** tied to the Broadcom–Anthropic financing story before the cutoff.

## TSM [Read-through]

- The available in-window reports did **not provide a quantified stock move, analyst rating change, price-target change, or named analyst note for TSM** tied to the Broadcom–Anthropic financing story before the cutoff.

## AVGO, GOOGL, NVDA, TSM [Market data and analyst actions]

- The available search results did **not contain verified October 2 regular-session or October 5 pre-market/intraday price moves** for AVGO, GOOGL, NVDA, or TSM through **12:20 ET on October 5, 2026**.

- The available search results did **not identify a named analyst, firm, rating change, or price-target change** for AVGO, GOOGL, NVDA, or TSM in the specified window.
